title: Fiery, single-vehicle accident kills a driver in rural south Polk - NewsBreak
text:
By Lakeland Ledger ,
12 hours ago A fiery, single-vehicle accident in a rural section of south Polk County killed a driver the morning of May 5.
The accident happened about 11:20 a.m. at Alturas Babson Park Cutoff Road and 80 Foot Road in Fort Meade, the Polk County Sheriff's Office said in a new release.
According to evidence at the scene, the Sheriff's Office said a 2014 Nissan four-door was traveling west on ABC Road at a high rate of speed. For unknown reasons, it left the roadway and struck a large metal utility pole with a three-foot base.
The Sheriff's Office said there were no brake marks indicating an attempt to stop. When the Nissan hit the pole, it caught fire, fully burning the car and surrounding grass.
First responders put out the fire and confirmed there was one person dead inside. Because of burns, the driver was not identified, but the Sheriff's Office said it appears to be an adult. A positive ID is pending an autopsy.
The investigation remains ongoing.
This article originally appeared on The Ledger: Fiery, single-vehicle accident kills a driver in rural south Polk
